assumptions.timeBase: Decay uses scaled gameplay time; hit stop pauses decay
assumptions.speedApplication: Snapshot speed at attack start; divide attack sections and contact delays by speed
assumptions.targets: One target, successful damage once per attack; no incoming damage, skill or enhanced attacks
assumptions.uptime: Fraction of gameplay time spent attacking; downtime is inserted after each full combo
assumptions.landing: Standing third attack adds height / fall speed; quantized is a separate 20 ms rounding approximation
assumptions.notMeasured: Not a Unity Play-mode measurement; terrain, collision and display-frame delays can change results
